mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN crm_customer c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN crm_project p ON t.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN manager_user u ON t.owner_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN manager_user cu ON t.create_user_id = cu.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_finance_contract ( contract_id, contract_no, contract_name, customer_id, project_id, owner_id, amount, sign_date, start_date, end_date, status, remark, source_type, source_text, ai_created, del_flag, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{contractId}, #{contractNo}, #{contractName}, #{customerId}, #{projectId}, #{ownerId}, #{amount}, #{signDate}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceText}, #{aiCreated}, #{delFlag}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_finance_contract SET contract_no = #{contractNo}, contract_name = #{contractName}, customer_id = #{customerId}, project_id = #{projectId}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, amount = #{amount}, sign_date = #{signDate}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, source_type = #{sourceType}, source_text = #{sourceText}, ai_created = #{aiCreated}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crm_finance_contract WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT t.contract_id AS id, t.contract_id, t.contract_no, t.contract_name, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.sign_date, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.status, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_contract t
WHERE AND t.sign_date >= #{query.startDate} AND t.sign_date <= #{query.endDate} ORDER BY t.sign_date DESC NULLS LAST, t.update_time DESC NULLS LAST, t.contract_id DESC

SELECT t.contract_id AS id, t.contract_id, t.contract_no, t.contract_name, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.sign_date, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.status, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_contract t
WHERE t.del_flag = 0 AND t.contract_id = #{contractId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_finance_receivable ( receivable_id, contract_id, customer_id, project_id, owner_id, title, amount, received_amount, due_date, status, remark, source_type, source_text, ai_created, del_flag, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{receivableId}, #{contractId}, #{customerId}, #{projectId}, #{ownerId}, #{title}, #{amount}, #{receivedAmount}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceText}, #{aiCreated}, #{delFlag}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_finance_receivable SET contract_id = #{contractId}, customer_id = #{customerId}, project_id = #{projectId}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, title = #{title}, amount = #{amount}, received_amount = #{receivedAmount}, due_date = #{dueDate}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, source_type = #{sourceType}, source_text = #{sourceText}, ai_created = #{aiCreated}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE receivable_id = #{receivableId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crm_finance_receivable WHERE receivable_id = #{receivableId} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT * FROM crm_finance_receivable WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status IN ('pending', 'partial', 'overdue') AND amount > received_amount AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY due_date ASC NULLS LAST, create_time ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.receivable_id AS id, t.receivable_id, t.contract_id, fc.contract_name, t.title, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.received_amount, (t.amount - t.received_amount) AS unpaid_amount, t.due_date, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('pending', 'partial', 'overdue') AND t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN (CURRENT_DATE - t.due_date)::INT ELSE 0 END AS overdue_days, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('pending', 'partial') AND t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'overdue' ELSE t.status END AS status, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_receivable t LEFT JOIN crm_finance_contract fc ON t.contract_id = fc.contract_id
WHERE AND t.due_date >= #{query.startDate} AND t.due_date <= #{query.endDate} AND t.status IN ('pending', 'partial', 'overdue') AND t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.due_date ASC NULLS LAST, t.create_time DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT t.receivable_id AS id, t.receivable_id, t.contract_id, fc.contract_name, t.title, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.received_amount, (t.amount - t.received_amount) AS unpaid_amount, t.due_date, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('pending', 'partial', 'overdue') AND t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN (CURRENT_DATE - t.due_date)::INT ELSE 0 END AS overdue_days, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('pending', 'partial') AND t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'overdue' ELSE t.status END AS status, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_receivable t LEFT JOIN crm_finance_contract fc ON t.contract_id = fc.contract_id
WHERE t.del_flag = 0 AND t.receivable_id = #{receivableId}

SELECT t.payment_id AS id, t.payment_id, t.receivable_id, t.contract_id, fc.contract_name, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.payment_date, t.payment_method, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_payment t LEFT JOIN crm_finance_contract fc ON t.contract_id = fc.contract_id
WHERE AND t.payment_date >= #{query.startDate} AND t.payment_date <= #{query.endDate} ORDER BY t.payment_date DESC, t.create_time DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT t.payment_id AS id, t.payment_id, t.receivable_id, t.contract_id, fc.contract_name, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.payment_date, t.payment_method, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_payment t LEFT JOIN crm_finance_contract fc ON t.contract_id = fc.contract_id
WHERE t.del_flag = 0 AND t.payment_id = #{paymentId}

SELECT t.invoice_id AS id, t.invoice_id, t.contract_id, t.receivable_id, fc.contract_name, t.invoice_no, t.title, t.tax_no, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.invoice_date, t.status, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_invoice t LEFT JOIN crm_finance_contract fc ON t.contract_id = fc.contract_id

SELECT t.invoice_id AS id, t.invoice_id, t.contract_id, t.receivable_id, fc.contract_name, t.invoice_no, t.title, t.tax_no, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.invoice_date, t.status, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_invoice t LEFT JOIN crm_finance_contract fc ON t.contract_id = fc.contract_id

SELECT t.expense_id AS id, t.expense_id, t.expense_type, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.expense_date, t.status, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_expense t
WHERE AND t.expense_date >= #{query.startDate} AND t.expense_date <= #{query.endDate} ORDER BY t.expense_date DESC, t.create_time DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT t.expense_id AS id, t.expense_id, t.expense_type, t.customer_id, c.company_name AS customer_name, t.project_id, p.name AS project_name, t.owner_id, u.realname AS owner_name, t.amount, t.expense_date, t.status, t.remark, t.source_type, t.source_text, t.ai_created, t.create_user_id, cu.realname AS create_user_name, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM crm_finance_expense t
WHERE t.del_flag = 0 AND t.expense_id = #{expenseId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - received_amount), 0) FROM crm_finance_receivable WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status IN ('pending', 'partial', 'overdue') AND due_date < #{today}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT payment_id AS id, '回款' AS title, amount, payment_date AS payment_date, customer_id, NULL::BIGINT AS project_id, create_time FROM crm_finance_payment WHERE del_flag = 0 UNION ALL SELECT expense_id AS id, expense_type AS title, amount, expense_date AS expense_date, customer_id, project_id, create_time FROM crm_finance_expense WHERE del_flag = 0 UNION ALL SELECT receivable_id AS id, title, amount - received_amount AS amount, due_date AS due_date, customer_id, project_id, create_time FROM crm_finance_receivable WHERE del_flag = 0 ) t ORDER BY create_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}

WITH months AS ( SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month', #{startDate}::date), date_trunc('month', #{endDate}::date), interval '1 month') AS month_start ), income AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', payment_date)::date AS month_start, SUM(amount) AS income FROM crm_finance_payment WHERE del_flag = 0 AND payment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY date_trunc('month', payment_date)::date ), expense AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', expense_date)::date AS month_start, SUM(amount) AS expense FROM crm_finance_expense WHERE del_flag = 0 AND expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY date_trunc('month', expense_date)::date ) SELECT to_char(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(i.income, 0) AS income, COALESCE(e.expense, 0) AS expense, COALESCE(i.income, 0) - COALESCE(e.expense, 0) AS net FROM months m LEFT JOIN income i ON i.month_start = m.month_start LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.month_start = m.month_start ORDER BY m.month_start
